column1: # Brunei, MORA (Jabatan Mufti Kerajaan): the ministry's public SharePoint list for Bandar Seri
# Begawan (Brunei-Muara district, minutes = 0), captured 2026-09-25. The full-year file has 9
# duplicate/typo rows (the ministry's own list, research: "one would put Fajr about 9 min early");
# they are dropped in the "-clean" file used to fit. September was captured again independently on
# the same day and held out as a small forward check; it differs from the full-year file's own
# September rows by up to a minute on a few days (site noise), which is exactly why it is kept
# separate rather than folded into the fit. Belait, Tutong and Temburong's own minutes are
# documented (mora.gov.bn), not checked against a table: they stay unmeasured (Muis.kt).
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): MORA's imsak (Subuh - 10) is a precaution these files do not hold;
# the fast begins at Subuh, so the Fajr column is also checked as the end of eating (F+E).

column1: # Ruling R162 (approved by the owner, 12 Nov 2026): a single-table page may span one day the authority itself
# misprinted, recorded here with its reason, when the misprinted cell is the only one left unchecked and the day's other
# columns are checked. 14 December 2026 is one of the 9 rows the "-clean" file drops: MORA prints its Dhuhr 9 min before
# both neighbouring days' and before the sun's noon that day (a Dhuhr before the zenith is no Dhuhr), while its other
# five columns run on from their neighbours by a minute or less. That one day's row, held out, checks those five
# columns (Fajr also as the end of eating) and leaves Dhuhr unchecked; Taqwa's Dhuhr that day is after the sun's noon,
# so it is not before even the misprinted minute. Without it R116 holds all of December at Bandar Seri Begawan.
